svg.desc: The cast of scenario 28: Job leaderboard-reset (one-off Job, the nightly reset); Service redis (stable name); Pod redis (holds the, leaderboard). Also: ConfigMap reset-script (the Python code). Your mission: Why did the reset give up after three tries?
